providers_ui.notification_settings_desc: Enable or disable specific notification types for this provider
providers_ui.notif_low_75_desc: Send notifications when 75% of data is consumed
providers_ui.notif_low_90_desc: Send notifications when 90% of data is consumed
providers_ui.notif_exp_3_desc: Send notifications 3 days before eSIM expires
providers_ui.notif_exp_1_desc: Send notifications 1 day before eSIM expires

providers_ui.preferred_section_subtitle: Set as preferred provider for auto package selection fallback
providers_ui.preferred_toggle_desc: When auto mode finds multiple best-price packages, prefer this provider
providers_ui.preferred_info_body: In auto mode, the system first identifies packages with the best price across all providers. If multiple providers offer the same best price, packages from the preferred provider are enabled automatically.
providers_ui.airalo_api_subtitle: Use OAuth2 client credentials from the Airalo developer console (not the public consumer API).
providers_ui.airalo_base_hint: Production base URL is usually https://partners-api.airalo.com (token: POST /v2/token, packages: GET /v2/packages).
providers_ui.oauth_secret_hint: Stored encrypted. Leave blank on update to keep the current secret.
providers_ui.oauth_secret_unchanged_placeholder: Leave blank to keep current secret
providers_ui.esim_access_api_subtitle: Reseller API sends accessCode and secretKey in the JSON body and RT-AccessCode / RT-SecretKey / RT-Timestamp / RT-RequestID headers (see docs.esimaccess.com / Postman). Save credentials before Test connection.
providers_ui.esim_access_base_hint: Usually https://api.esimaccess.com — confirm paths in your API version.
providers_ui.esim_access_secret_placeholder_new: Paste secret key from developer console — then Save changes
providers_ui.esim_access_secret_hint_new: Copy the secret key from your eSIM Access console (Developer / API). Click Save changes at the bottom before using Test connection — unsaved text is not sent to the API.
providers_ui.esim_access_secret_hint: Stored encrypted. Leave blank on update to keep the current secret.
providers_ui.esim_access_secret_stored_visible: Secret key is saved on the server. The field looks empty on purpose (we never show secrets). Type a new key only if you want to replace it.
providers_ui.esim_access_save_reminder: Secret key is not saved on the server yet. Paste it above and click Save changes, then use Test connection.
providers_ui.esim_access_test_requires_saved_secret: Save changes first so your secret key is stored; Test connection uses saved credentials only.
providers_ui.esim_access_merchant_balance_path_hint: Postman uses {{host}} = https://api.esimaccess.com and paths like api/v1/open/…. Leave blank to try defaults, or copy the exact path from the Get merchant balance request.
providers_ui.esim_access_package_list_path_hint: Postman package list is often POST {{host}}/api/v1/open/package/list. Leave blank to try defaults, or paste the path after the host (e.g. api/v1/open/package/list).
providers_ui.package_list_body_hint: Optional extra fields merged with credentials (e.g. filters). Use {} if unsure.
providers_ui.esim_access_invalid_json: Package list body must be valid JSON.
providers_ui.maya_api_subtitle: Connect+ / partner API credentials from Maya (base URL and paths may differ — use your Maya documentation).
providers_ui.maya_base_hint: Default https://api.maya.net — confirm the host and version with Maya.
providers_ui.maya_auth_mode_hint: Bearer sends Authorization: Bearer {key}. Basic uses key as username and secret as password when a secret is configured.
providers_ui.maya_api_secret_hint: Required for Basic auth on first save. Stored encrypted. Leave blank on update to keep the current secret.
providers_ui.maya_path_placeholder_optional: Optional — for connection test if different from package list
providers_ui.maya_package_list_body_hint: Optional query/body fields merged into the package list request (e.g. filters). Use {} if unsure.
providers_ui.maya_invalid_json: Package list body must be valid JSON.
providers_ui.esim_go_api_subtitle: Use your API key from Account Settings → API Details (portal.esim-go.com). Requests use the X-API-Key header per docs.esim-go.com.
providers_ui.esim_go_base_hint: Usually https://api.esim-go.com — catalogue defaults to v2.4/catalogue (adjust path if you use another API version).
providers_ui.esim_go_api_key_hint: Sent as header X-API-Key on every request. Stored encrypted.
providers_ui.esim_go_path_placeholder_optional: Optional — override for connection test (otherwise GET catalogue with perPage=1)
providers_ui.esim_go_package_list_body_hint: Optional extra query params merged into catalogue requests (e.g. perPage, countries). Pagination uses page and perPage.
providers_ui.esim_go_invalid_json: Package list body must be valid JSON.
